contract_assessments.assessment: [contract:S06; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M06A/ParameterContinuity.lean; dep:H06; dep:D03; dep:S05] The export establishes continuity of the S05-unique stationary resource law throughout the strictly impatient admissible normalized-price subtype, fixing utility, beta and the labor law. It derives D03's uniform bounds locally, obtains common tail support through compact economic-kernel existence and full-space uniqueness, and proves subsequential-limit invariance explicitly. H06 gives joint test-operator continuity; restriction to [0,B] gives uniform convergence, while weak convergence handles the fixed limiting operator. Tightness and uniqueness identify every cluster point and yield full sequential, then topological, continuity. Inspected embedding helpers preserve the actual household kernel and introduce no extra economic premise. [source:A93; source:SLP89] The argument faithfully reconstructs Proposition 5's continuity claim using Theorem 12.13. It establishes neither boundary uniformity nor stronger distributional or moment convergence.

dimension_assessments.summary: The export gives continuity on every strictly impatient admissible normalized price, fixing U, beta and nu. A separate theorem explicitly proves invariance of every weak limit with common compact support.

Local drift bounds yield common tail support via genuine compact invariance and full-space uniqueness. Uniform convergence of restricted test operators plus weak convergence passes invariance to limits. Tightness, unique cluster points and first-countable price topology establish continuity.

Resources follow z'=R*A(z)+w*l+k, with shifted savings chosen before the fresh iid labor draw. withPrices replaces only normalized prices. The law is a resource distribution; original debt coordinates retain the normalization-bridge qualification.

Rendered A93 printed 39–40/original PDF 40–41 and SLP89 printed 384–385/original PDF 394–395 support Proposition 5's continuity claim and Theorem 12.13's subsequence proof. Local support construction and normalized-coordinate bridges are formal reconstructions.

No stationary-law continuity, tightness or common support is assumed by the target. Conditional helper premises are proved at their call sites, and the strictly impatient admissible price domain is nonempty.
The diff adds S06 and its audits without modifying accepted proofs. H06, D03 and S05 retain certified interfaces; reused compact-kernel helpers belong to S05's accepted dependency closure.

Resources remain NNReal. Labor is an arbitrary probability law on its compact interval with essential endpoint neighborhoods; no grid, density or finite-support restriction appears. The iid law stays fixed.

S06 includes zero in the common resource interval but uses no marginal object. It preserves the accepted restriction that rightMarginalValue applies economically only at positive states; zeroRightMarginal remains the possibly infinite economic boundary object.

New integrals use bounded continuous tests under probability measures; domination and integral_sub integrability are supplied. S06 adds no ENNReal-to-Real conversion. The reused crossing bridge proves epsE≠∞ from a probability bound before converting.

ProbabilityMeasure convergence is used through bounded continuous test integrals. Uniform convergence concerns test operators on [0,B], not total variation of laws. Neither the export nor ledger asserts unbounded-test or moment convergence.

[context:qualifications] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive states. Never interpret rightMarginalValue m 0 as the economic boundary marginal. That boundary is zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal and may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is a separate utility endpoint object. H06 and contract D02 use no marginal object; contract D03 and S02 use rightMarginalValue only after proving positivity. The new S06 argument uses no marginal object or boundary substitution.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean] The maintained household scope is bounded utility, continuous resources and a general compact iid-income law. P03's two-point distribution establishes primitive consistency only and does not restrict the general law. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope. H01–H04 retain BASIC-only assumptions and constructed canonical objects without impatience. H01 is a bounded-continuous Bellman self-map on unbounded NNReal with beta contraction and a general labor law; actual actions lie in [0,z], with shares auxiliary. H02 constructs the canonical fixed point, proves uniqueness among bounded continuous fixed points and uniform value iteration, and bounds value using inf U and sup U over all nonnegative consumption. H03 establishes ordinary real convex-combination concavity and strict increase without derivatives. H04 constructs the unique actual shifted-asset maximizer, uses shares only at positive resources, handles zero by feasibility, and satisfies c(z)+A(z)=z. No CoreRegularity, impatience, differentiability, invariant-law, bounded-asset or finite-state assumption enters H01–H04.

[context:qualifications] P01 proves budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. P02 finite-cap continuity fixes the cap and labor floor, treats r=0 separately and includes the zero-cap case. Its natural-cap branch requires r>0 and asserts no continuity of the raw natural borrowing limit through zero.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M04A/JointContinuity.lean] M02B's lifetime interpretation is an absolutely convergent series of expected flows under finite-history product laws, covering admitted measurable full-history feasible plans. No literal infinite-product lifetime random variable is constructed. Translation to the original budget remains conditional on normalization from OriginalPrices. The normalized affine income intercept equals -(R-1)*phi when obtained through that bridge. S06 proves continuity in admissible normalized (R,w,k) coordinates and does not remove the original-coordinate qualification.

[context:qualifications] H07 establishes weak-order and Lipschitz properties, without policy differentiability or strict-order conclusions. [context:qualifications] H11 is local, requires positive consumption at the quantified positive state and holds for every admissible R>0. It proves neither global consumption positivity, an envelope identity at zero consumption, an Euler equation nor a separate derivative-continuity theorem.

[context:qualifications] H12 applies at positive current resources under BASIC, SMOOTH and beta*R<1. Its conditional marginal retains zeroRightMarginal at zero next resources.
